## History

Before his death, James married [Emily](../character/emily.md) and took a fortnight-long wedding trip to St. John before returning to their home in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). He also received a parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) from his dying sailor brother, whom he had been close to as a child. When [Emily](../character/emily.md) issued an ultimatum demanding he choose between her and the parrot, James refused to part with [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), leading [Emily](../character/emily.md) to leave him and return to her own house.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Relationships

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--james-a.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is the long-lost wife of James A, who unexpectedly returned to his home after a past separation. Following her arrival, James admitted to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he was glad to have his wife back in his life. The couple reconciled their household and resumed living together as husband and wife.
